in_hebrew.name: הליא
in_hebrew.meaning: name הליא means light, shining, radiant, or illuminated in Hebrew
in_hebrew.long_meaning: name הליא has Hebrew roots from הל (hal) meaning to shine or be radiant, associated with divine light (Psalm 119:105), spiritual illumination (Matthew 6:22), and enlightenment (John 8:12), often attributed to qualities of kindness, wisdom, and guidance in Christian tradition

in_greek.name: Ἑλία
in_greek.meaning: name Ἑλία means light, radiant, shining, or illuminated in Greek
in_greek.long_meaning: name Ἑλία is derived from Greek word ἕλα (hela) meaning to shine or be radiant, linked to Greek mythology and divine light, in Christian tradition associated with virtues of kindness, wisdom, and spiritual guidance, as seen in the Gospel of John (1:4-5) and the Book of Revelation (21:23)

in_latin.name: Helia
in_latin.meaning: name Helia means light, shining, radiant, or illuminated in Latin
in_latin.long_meaning: name Helia originates from Latin word helios, referring to the sun and its radiant light, in Christian tradition signifying divine illumination, spiritual guidance, and enlightenment, often associated with virtues of kindness, wisdom, and compassion, as exemplified in the writings of early Christian Fathers
